sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fast-Casual Self-Serve Broth Bowl Master Licensing

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Hong Kong SAR) of the People's Republic of China, serving as the intermediate offshore holding jurisdiction for the onshore Mainland China Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law in the Hong Kong SAR parent jurisdiction; Civil Law statutory regime governing the Mainland China WFOE formation under the PRC Foreign Investment Law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Mainland and Hong Kong Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement (CEPA) including the Investment Agreement signed at Kuala Lumpur on 28 June 2017

Arrangement between the Mainland of China and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for the Avoidance of Double Taxation on Income, signed 21 August 2006 and amended by the Fifth Protocol executed 10 July 2019
People's Republic of China Foreign Investment Law (effective 1 January 2020) and the Special Administrative Measures (Negative List) for Foreign Investment Access, 2024 version

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: People's Republic of China Anti-Money Laundering Law (revised 8 November 2024, effective 1 January 2025); PBOC and SAMR Joint Order No. 3, Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Enterprises (promulgated 26 April 2024, effective 1 November 2024); SAMR Market Entity Registration Regulations and Enterprise Name Registration Administration Rules; Hong Kong Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622, Part 12 Division 13 Significant Controllers Register); Hong Kong Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615, as amended by the AMLO Amendment Ordinance 2022)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Hong Kong SAR parent company (registered under the Companies Ordinance, Cap. 622)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel and mutually exclusive tracks: (A) Hague Apostille by the High Court of Hong Kong (Registry Office) only when the destination is an Apostille Convention member state; (B) Consular Legalization by the destination state's consulate in Hong Kong after the Companies Registry certificate is produced and the High Court authenticates signatory capacity, applicable only for non-member states; (C) for use in Mainland China SAMR filings, notarization by a Hong Kong Notary Public followed by attestation of the notary seal by the China Legal Service (HK) Limited. Apostille and Consular Legalization must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Current Status) of the Hong Kong SAR parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel tracks only. For an Apostille Convention member state, affix a High Court of Hong Kong Apostille Certificate to the Companies Registry certified extract; for a non-member state, after High Court authentication, submit to the destination consulate for Consular Legalization; for Mainland China domestic filings, apply the Hong Kong Notary Public plus China Legal Service (HK) Limited attestation channel. Apostille and Consular Legalization are mutually exclusive and must not be combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Hong Kong SAR parent company authorizing the incorporation of the Mainland China WFOE and granting a Power of Attorney to the designated PRC law firm and registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Hong Kong SAR parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The executed resolution must be notarized by a Hong Kong Notary Public; thereafter, if the receiving authority is located in an Apostille Convention member state, only the High Court of Hong Kong Hague Apostille is to be obtained; if the receiving authority is located in a non-member state, only consular legalization at that state's consulate in Hong Kong applies; if the receiving authority is SAMR or a PRC bank within Mainland China, the notarized resolution is attested solely by the China Legal Service (HK) Limited. No sequential chaining of Apostille and Consular Legalization is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Memorandum and Articles, M&A) of the Hong Kong SAR parent company, conformed certified copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Companies Registry (certified true copy) with confirmation by the company secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Use the High Court of Hong Kong Apostille for Apostille Convention member states; use destination-consulate Consular Legalization for non-member states; use the Hong Kong Notary Public plus China Legal Service (HK) Limited attestation for Mainland China. The three channels are parallel, and Apostille may never be layered with Consular Legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Hong Kong SAR parent company issued on licensed bank letterhead, countersigned by the relationship manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Hong Kong banking institution (issuing branch relationship management office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For a Mainland China bank account opening at a PRC bank, the Bank Reference Letter must be notarized by a Hong Kong Notary Public and attested by the China Legal Service (HK) Limited; for submission to banks or regulators in Apostille Convention member states, the High Court of Hong Kong Apostille is the sole authentication; for non-member states, consular legalization at the relevant consulate is required. Apostille and Consular Legalization are alternative, never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized identity, residential address, source-of-funds and UBO declaration package for each director and ultimate beneficial owner of the WFOE chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Notary Public (acting on original passports, utility bills and bank statements)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Parallel track: High Court of Hong Kong Apostille for Apostille Convention states; Consular Legalization at the destination consulate for non-member states; China Legal Service (HK) Limited attestation after notarization for Mainland China use. The bundle must never combine Apostille and Consular Legalization for the same destination.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Every individual shareholder, director, ultimate beneficial owner and authorized signatory of the Hong Kong parent and the proposed Mainland China WFOE must be screened in real time against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN and non-SDN SSI lists, the UK HM Treasury consolidated sanctions list, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, the Hong Kong SAR United Nations Sanctions designation list (Cap. 537), and the People's Republic of China MOFCOM and PBOC sanctions and export-control annexes. PEP screening is applied on a full-scope basis covering immediate family members and close associates, with enhanced due diligence requiring notarized source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence whenever a PEP flag, sanction match, or adverse-media item is triggered. All screening outcomes, logic, evidence snapshots and clearance approvals must be archived, held for at least five years after the business relationship ends, and re-run every 90 days and immediately upon any ownership, control, or signatory change; results must be delivered in English and Pinyin romanization for the WFOE's KYC bank account opening and SAMR UBO registration.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Self-Service Reservation System (online name search and pre-approval module of the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System), administered by the district-level SAMR office in the target Mainland China registration city; concurrently checked against the Hong Kong Companies Registry online name search to ensure English-name consistency for the parent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The WFOE must adopt a four-tier Chinese statutory name in the fixed order: (1) administrative division of the registered office; (2) a distinctive trade name of at least two Chinese characters, which may not be composed solely of numerals or Latin letters; (3) an industry or business-scope description aligned with fast-casual self-serve food-service franchise activity; and (4) the legal-form suffix meaning limited company. Because the proposed Chinese trade name must have a corresponding Pinyin romanization for PRC bank and tax filings, the English name of the WFOE will be rendered as the Pinyin transliteration of the trade name plus the industry descriptor plus the company form, and must be registered on the same SAMR application; the English name must not depart materially from the Chinese-script name, and any deviation must be justified in the incorporation application. The four-tier structure must avoid identical or near-identical names in the national SAMR database and respect the distinctiveness hierarchy and adjudication rules under the Enterprise Name Registration Administration Rules.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the local SAMR office rejects the proposed name, the applicant must first request the written rejection decision setting out the cited conflict or prohibition grounds. Within 60 days from receipt of the decision, the applicant may submit an administrative reconsideration petition to the immediately superior SAMR administration under the Administrative Reconsideration Law of the People's Republic of China, attaching the original reservation receipt, a comparative analysis demonstrating non-confliction with the cited registrations, and, where applicable, the registered trademark certificate or notarized parent-company name authorization in English. Alternatively, within 6 months the applicant may file an administrative lawsuit at the competent People's Court in the district where the registering SAMR sits. The appeal submission should simultaneously reserve two to three backup names in both Chinese-script form and Pinyin romanization so that the incorporation timeline is preserved; if the name was rejected for lack of distinctiveness, each backup name should incorporate an additional distinctive syllable, a geographic indicator, or a brand element already registered as a trademark by the Hong Kong parent, and the appeal must include proof that the proposed name does not mislead as to the WFOE's ownership or confuse the public.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For this ISIC 5610 fast-casual self-serve broth-bowl franchise WFOE, a virtual office or commercial-mailbox address is not permissible as the WFOE's registered office: the local SAMR office requires a physical operating premises for the catering business, the municipal taxation bureau requires matching rent invoices and utility bills, the Food Business License (issued by SAMR) demands an on-site food-handling area, and commercial banks mandate a site inspection before any corporate account is activated. A serviced-office address may be acceptable only if the WFOE actually occupies a dedicated room in an approved business center within the registration district, and separate brick-and-mortar food-service premises must be leased,

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), articles on company establishment, registered capital and corporate governance; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 4, 8, 15 and 31; Regulations on the Administration of Market Entity Registration (2021), Articles 1 through 35.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Regulation Administration of the district where the WFOE is registered
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form, together with the Articles of Association, filed through the unified National Enterprise Integration Online Service Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital applies to the WFOE under the Company Law, unless a separately regulated industry imposes a sector-specific amount. Under the 2023 revision, shareholders must pay the full subscribed capital within five years of establishment or earlier if the Articles of Association or a law requires it. No blocked escrow account is mandated; however, the foreign shareholder must remit capital into a dedicated foreign exchange capital account supervised by a SAFE-designated bank, and each contribution requires an FDI registration certificate and a remittance record in the SAFE system.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
THE FIRST WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CN WFOE LTD

ADOPTED BY WRITTEN CONSENT on [date], pursuant to the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), the Foreign Investment Law and the Articles of Association of CN WFOE LTD (the Company). The undersigned directors, constituting the First Board of Directors, unanimously resolve as follows:

1. INCORPORATION AND SHARE CAPITAL: RESOLVED, that the establishment of the Company as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise is ratified. The registered capital is set at [amount in RMB], divided into [number] shares, all subscribed by the sole shareholder. The sole shareholder shall pay the subscribed capital in full within the period required by law and the Articles of Association. The shareholder's liability is limited to the unpaid amount of the shares. The directors are directed to accept the contribution, to issue contribution certificates and to complete all filings with the State Administration for Foreign Exchange.

2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED, that the Company shall open a basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at a bank lawfully operating in the People's Republic of China. The legal representative, or any director designated by the legal representative in writing, is authorized to complete, sign, endorse and file account opening applications, bank mandates, wire transfer instructions, foreign exchange registration forms and all ancillary documents necessary to receive and administer the registered capital.

3. REGISTERED OFFICE: RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company is established at the address stated in the Articles of Association, being [address]. The directors are authorized to execute the lease or use agreement, to register the address with the local Administration for Market Regulation, and to maintain the statutory books, registers, seals and corporate records at that office.

4. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed as legal representative and executive director, [Name] as general manager, [Name] as supervisor, and [Name] as compliance officer. Such officers are empowered to exercise the powers delegated in the Articles of Association, including entering into contracts, engaging employees, preparing financial records, applying for Food Business, fire, environmental and other permits, and representing the Company before all government authorities.

5. BUSINESS SCOPE: RESOLVED, that the Board adopts the business scope covering fast-casual self-serve broth bowl restaurant management, master franchise licensing, centralized kitchen support to the extent permitted and related catering services. The officers are directed to secure the Food Business License, the environmental registration filing and the fire safety clearance before the commencement of operations.

6. AUTHORITY AND EFFECTIVE DATE: RESOLVED, that this resolution is effective as of the date signed by all directors, requires no further shareholder ratification except where mandatory law provides otherwise, and prevails over any conflicting internal guidance. The corporate secretary shall place this resolution in the minute book and furnish certified copies to banks, government authorities and auditors upon request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Name Reservation System through the local Administration for Market Regulation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare two proposed Chinese trade names with English equivalents and run an online search. Submit the name reservation application through the official one-window online service of the Municipal Administration for Market Regulation. The system checks for prohibited characters, confusingly similar names and restricted expressions. Once approved, the system issues a Name Pre-approval Notice. The applicant must complete real-name verification of the proposed legal representative or authorized agent before submission. Should the name be refused, the applicant may submit a revised name request through the same portal without re-filing the full dossier.
required_dossiers: completed name reservation application
passport or Chinese identity document of the proposed legal representative
identity document and business registration certificate of the sole foreign shareholder
authorization letter to the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is queried or rejected, the applicant may ask the registry for the written grounds, file a revised name application on the same online platform, or apply for administrative reconsideration under the Administrative Reconsideration Law within the applicable limitation period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization, apostille and certified Chinese translation of the Hong Kong parent company documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Hong Kong Companies Registry, a China-appointed Hong Kong notary public and the notarization or translation channel designated by the SAMR office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain from the Hong Kong parent company the Certificate of Incorporation, current Business Registration Certificate, director and shareholder register and a Hong Kong board resolution approving the creation of the WFOE. These originals must be notarized by a Hong Kong notary public and, where required, apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention before submission in China. Have the apostilled documents translated into Simplified Chinese by a certified translation agency. Verify that each page of the Chinese translation carries the translator seal and that the English original and Chinese translation are bound together. Retain the notary certificate and the translator registration for the registry file.
required_dossiers: certified true copy of the Hong Kong parent Certificate of Incorporation
current Hong Kong Business Registration Certificate
registered list of directors and shareholders of the Hong Kong parent
Hong Kong parent board resolution approving the WFOE
apostille certificate issued by the competent Hong Kong authority
certified Chinese translation with translator seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Hong Kong notary public or the Chinese registry rejects the documents, the rejected set may be corrected and re-notarized by the same institution; if the translation is found inaccurate, retain a different certified translator and resubmit the corrected bilingual set before the SAMR response deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the WFOE establishment registration with the Market Regulation Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration (for example, the Shanghai Municipal Administration for Market Regulation) through the One-Stop Foreign Investment Online Service portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form and the Articles of Association in the electronic registry. Attach the notarized shareholder qualification documents, lease agreement, property ownership certificate or landlord consent, the appointment documents for the legal representative, supervisor and executive director, and the capital contribution schedule. All applicants must pass real-name verification by scanning the official identity verification application. The registry examines the documents, and on approval issues the Business License for Enterprise Legal Person with the unified social credit code. After issuance, the applicant should print the license and download the electronic version for later tax and seal filings.
required_dossiers: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Establishment Registration Application Form
Articles of Association approved by the sole shareholder
notarized and apostilled shareholder qualification certificates
appointment letter of the legal representative, supervisor and executive director
lease agreement for the registered office and property ownership certificate
Name Pre-approval Notice
capital contribution schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Should the SAMR suspend the application, the applicant receives a correction notice and may cure the deficiencies within ten working days. If the registration is refused, the applicant may file administrative reconsideration within sixty days or bring an administrative lawsuit within six months of service of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration statutory filings: seals, tax, social insurance, bank account and SAFE foreign direct investment registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-authorized seal engraving office, State Taxation Administration office, Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, and a SAFE-designated commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty days of obtaining the Business License, engrave the company seal, financial seal, legal representative seal and contract seal at an authorized seal engraving office. Complete tax registration, including VAT taxpayer qualification and the tax reporting profile. Register the company as an employer for social insurance and the housing provident fund. Open a basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at a bank that handles SAFE FDI declarations. Complete the FDI registration form and authorize the bank to file the registration with the SAFE portal under the assigned investment project code. Confirm the social insurance contribution account with the district social security office and retain the bank mandate in the corporate records.
required_dossiers: Business License original and duplicate
appointment certificates of legal representative and general manager
seal engraving application and authorization letter
tax registration form and unified social credit code certificate
SAFE FDI registration form with capital contribution schedule
bank account application and company resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority, social insurance office or SAFE bank queries the filings, the company must provide corrected resolutions and identity documents within the response period. A delayed SAFE filing may be remediated through a late registration application at the same bank; if the bank refuses the remittance, obtain a fresh certificate and ask the next SAFE-designated bank to re-file after the company updates the business license and seal records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial and environmental licensing for fast-casual restaurant and franchise operation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation food business division, local Ecological Environment Bureau environmental registration portal, and local Fire and Rescue Brigade
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before commencing any cooking or service activity, apply for the Food Business License under the Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China. Submit the floor plan, food safety management system, equipment list, water supply and drainage drawings, health certificate roster and the completed Food Business License application form. In parallel, complete the online environmental registration filing for catering services and obtain the fire safety inspection certificate from the Fire and Rescue Brigade. The food authority conducts an onsite inspection and posts the license in the restaurant. For master franchise licensing, maintain the trademark registration certificate and franchise disclosure records. No operation is permitted until the licenses and registration receipt are in force.
required_dossiers: Food Business License application form
Business License for Enterprise Legal Person
identity documents and health certificates of food employees
floor plan and kitchen equipment layout
food safety management system handbook
lease and property ownership documents for the site
fire safety inspection certificate application
online environmental registration filing receipt
trademark registration certificate and franchising records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the food authority finds deficiencies during onsite inspection, the applicant receives a rectification notice and re-inspection is completed within ten working days. If the fire inspection certificate is denied, remedy the cited fire protection defects and submit a new application through the same fire and rescue administrative window. The environmental registration filing may be corrected online before the certificate is required for the annual compliance review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal Administration for Market Regulation food regulatory division, local Ecological Environment Bureau, and the Fire and Rescue Brigade under the Emergency Management Bureau
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business License for Catering and Restaurant Services, together with a Before-Opening Fire Safety Inspection Certificate and an Online Environmental Registration Filing Receipt

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau, a local agency of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (filing) under Category 90 of the Construction Project Environmental Impact Assessment Classification Management List (2021), with no full EIA report or EIA form required for a standard restaurant using municipal water and sewer, provided kitchen fume purification is installed and the site is not within a prohibited sensitive zone
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Kitchen fume purification must comply with GB 18483-2001, with average oil-fume emission concentration in the exhaust duct not exceeding 2.0 mg/m³ and removal efficiency meeting the applicable standard. Wastewater discharged into the municipal sewer must comply with GB/T 31962-2015, including pH 6-9, COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 300 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 400 mg/L, and oil and grease not exceeding 100 mg/L. Separated waste cooking oil and food residue must be collected by a licensed recycling entity and recorded in the kitchen waste transfer ledger; any hazardous waste must be stored in clearly labeled sealed containers and transferred only to a licensed hazardous waste disposal operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Obtain a Fire Safety Inspection Certificate before opening; install approved fire extinguishers, emergency lighting, evacuation signage and smoke detection or alarm equipment as applicable. Ensure the kitchen grease extraction, gas installation and commercial cooking equipment meet structural load and gas safety standards. Complete workplace safety registration with the local Emergency Management Bureau, maintain food hygiene and employee safety training records, and keep the fire inspection and occupational safety files available for government inspection.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA) and the National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau (ETB) for the province or municipality where the WFOE is registered.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The foreign shareholder incorporates the WFOE with the local Administration for Market Regulation (AMR) and files the foreign investment information report; the franchise/restaurant scope is not on the foreign investment negative list, but the Food Business License must be obtained prior to operations. Step 2: The AMR issues the Business License bearing the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which legally serves as the WFOE's tax identification number (TIN) for all national taxes, including VAT and corporate income tax. Step 3: Under the integration of multiple certificates into one business license with one code regime, the AMR automatically pushes registration data to the STA; no separate tax registration certificate is obtained. Step 4: Within 30 days of Business License issuance, the legal representative, tax designated personnel, and accounting controller must perform tax onboarding in the National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau, confirming the WFOE's tax profile, banking and capital account details, accounting standards, sector classification, tax filing calendars, and SAFE foreign-exchange registration through the bank. Step 5: The WFOE completes VAT taxpayer classification, electing small-scale or general taxpayer status, and applies for the digital e-invoice quota. Step 6: For the Hong Kong non-resident parent, the WFOE registers non-resident enterprise information with the STA for withholding tax on dividends, royalties, interest, and service fees, and must be prepared to substantiate beneficial ownership for reduced treaty rates under the Mainland and Hong Kong Arrangement. A foreign non-resident entity with no PRC permanent establishment may separately obtain a non-resident tax registration number through the STA or its withholding agent solely for China-source income payment filing.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - the WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise liable to Enterprise Income Tax on worldwide income at the 25% statutory headline rate; it is not pass-through, not a territorial company, and does not automatically enjoy tax-exempt zone treatment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None for U.S.-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections; PRC law does not permit the WFOE to be disregarded. The only operational election relevant to this entity is the VAT classification election: annual taxable turnover below RMB 5,000,000 permits small-scale taxpayer treatment at the 3% collection rate, while the WFOE may elect general taxpayer status to claim input VAT credits and apply the 6% catering/franchise service rate; simplified VAT treatment for certain cross-border service categories may also be elected where admissible.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) administered by STA; ancillary indirect taxes include urban maintenance and construction tax and education surcharges levied on assessed VAT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All business entities must complete tax registration at establishment. Mandatory general VAT taxpayer registration is triggered when annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000. Below RMB 5,000,000 the WFOE may remain a small-scale taxpayer at the 3% collection rate or elect general taxpayer status. Catering services and franchise licensing under this fast-casual self-serve model carry the 6% VAT rate for general taxpayers, while separate sales of tangible goods and equipment attract the standard 13% VAT goods rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China mandates issuance of digital e-invoices, known as fully digitalised electronic invoices, through the STA Electronic Invoice Service Platform in the National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau. Each invoice is assigned a unique 20-digit invoice number and official digital seal; the platform validates and records every invoice in real time before delivery to the buyer, operating as tax-authority clearance. Physical tax-control devices are being phased out; ERP-to-platform API integration is available, but all invoice issuance must be synchronised with STA central systems. Anti-fraud numbering, automatic reconciliation of invoice data, and mandatory electronic archiving apply; paper fiscal stamps are no longer required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods: the WFOE must be a general VAT taxpayer and must physically export goods from China's customs territory to an overseas customer; the sale must be evidenced by a customs export declaration, transport documents, commercial invoice, and receipt of export proceeds in foreign exchange. For qualifying cross-border services, zero-rating or VAT exemption applies only where the service is completely consumed outside mainland China and supplied to an overseas or Hong Kong recipient under the cross-border VAT rules, including the framework of Caishui 2016 No. 36 and related announcements. A franchise royalty or catering master-license arrangement with a Hong Kong licensee will qualify only if the licensed brand activity and delivery are substantiated as occurring outside mainland China; intra-group management services supplied to Hong Kong must be evidenced as not used in mainland China. Export VAT zero-rating is not automatic; the export declaration and rebate documentation must be filed through the ETB with supporting evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: China Customs Export Goods Declaration Form
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Export Sales Contract or Purchase Order
Bank Foreign Exchange Receipt Voucher or SAFE Trade Monitoring System record evidencing inward remittance within the statutory period
Transport and warehouse evidence including container number, vessel or air shipment reference, and delivery confirmation
VAT export refund application and supporting input VAT invoice records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: STA and customs jointly audit export zero-rating claims against export declarations, logistics events, invoice data, and SAFE foreign-exchange records. If zero-rating is disallowed, the WFOE must output-reverse the recovered VAT, pay the underlying VAT with a daily late-payment surcharge at 0.05% of the tax due, and may face an administrative penalty of 0.5 to 5 times the underpaid or fraudulently refunded tax. Falsely declared exports or forged documents attract criminal liability for export tax fraud, including fines, confiscation, and imprisonment up to life for major cases. Temporary or permanent suspension of export tax rebate status and loss of simplified trade privileges may also be imposed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, within the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Chinese Renminbi is conditionally convertible on current account and controlled on capital account. Current account trade and service transactions are generally permitted for settlement and payment subject to truthfulness review by licensed banks, while capital account transactions such as FDI injections by foreign shareholders require prior SAFE registration or approval. A WFOE established under a Hong Kong parent must register the inbound equity investment through SAFE and open a distinct Foreign Exchange Capital Account before receiving the remittance. Once credited, the foreign currency capital may be settled into RMB for working capital using the capital settlement procedures, but it cannot be used for currency trading, lending, or investments outside the approved business scope. Profit remittance for dividends is permissible after annual audit, CIT settlement, and the bank's review of the board resolution and tax vouchers; there is no blanket repatriation tax, but the dividend withholding tax or treaty rate must be cleared. The practical constraint is not formal convertibility but documentary rigidity, transaction-by-transaction supervision through the SAFE monitoring system, and the requirement for all funding to have genuine underlying operational purpose.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: China has moved away from compulsory surrender ratios. A WFOE engaged in food-service trade must repatriate export and cross-border e-commerce proceeds into a domestic foreign exchange settlement account through a designated bank. The general trade supervision timeline is tied to the customs export declaration and subsequent banking receipt verification; proceeds that are not verified within the standard SAFE monitoring cycle, commonly 180 days for trade credit terms unless extended by registration, require an extension application. The bank will execute settlement into RMB according to the enterprise's instruction; if the account retains foreign exchange above the approved retention ceiling, the surplus must be settled or moved into a controlled debt or liquidity structure.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (FDI Equity Injection Escrow)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Basic Deposit Account (RMB Operational) with current-account FX settlement sub-ledger
Capital Account plus Settlement Proceeds Account for franchise and royalty receipts

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury and capital-account bank. Offshore digital EMIs and non-bank fintech platforms such as Airwallex, Currencycloud, and Revolut Business are not licensed deposit-taking institutions in the PRC and cannot open corporate bank accounts for a WFOE. Under SAFE and PBOC regulations, a WFOE must maintain its statutory registers, capital verification, and trade collection and repayment flows in a domestic SAFE-approved bank. A fintech EMI can only serve as a support ancillary rail for low-value merchant collection or international e-commerce settlement if the service is supplied by a PBOC-licensed payment institution acting through a domestic partner bank, but it cannot receive SAFE-registered FDI capital, cannot execute capital-factored trade settlements, and cannot replace the local banking account opening obligation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical branch attendance is generally mandatory for the newly incorporated WFOE. The statutory legal representative or an authorized controller with a notarized power of attorney must attend at least the initial KYC interview, and most Tier-1 banks require the legal representative to appear in person for board resolution verification and biometric capture. Remote opening without any onshore visit is not permitted for foreign-invested entities; consular proxy opening is generally accepted only for adding non-legal-representative signatories, not for the first capital account. The bank will also conduct an address inspection and onsite verification of the registered business premise, which is essential given the food service licence requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Hong Kong intermediate holding company with nominee shareholders or layered ownership obscuring the ultimate beneficial owner behind the Chinese WFOE.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A full corporate registry and UBO breakdown: HK Business Registration Certificate, incorporation form NNC1, updated Annual Return NAR1, register of members and directors, beneficial owner declaration under the Hong Kong Companies Ordinance, notarized declarations of trust or nominee relationship, passport copies, and source-of-wealth statements for each natural person UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Material mismatch between reported franchise royalty income and low-transparency POS cash flows from the self-serve Malatang dining model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Public food service licence, trademark or franchise registration certificate, master franchise agreement with tiered royalty formula, sample store P&L and bank or POS merchant statements for at least three months, VAT returns, and tax filings proving data consistency with the forecast royalty base.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border movement of capital from Hong Kong parent without verifiable source of funds or clear FDI purpose code.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements of the Hong Kong parent, twelve-month bank statements of the remitting account, board resolution approving the capital injection, SAFE FDI registration certificate, contract or term sheet setting the equity issuance, and an accountant's capital verification report after receipt.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money-laundering risk embedded in imports of dry spices, frozen food, or kitchen equipment from third-country suppliers at inconsistent transfer pricing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commercial invoices, bills of lading or airway bills, customs declarations, inspection and health certificates, supplier KYC and licence dossier, transfer-pricing documentation with benchmark analysis, and a written operations narrative reconciling shipping routes, storage capacity, and menu recipe unit economics.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Hong Kong parent must first complete SAFE's foreign direct investment registration and obtain the FDI registration confirmation code through a designated PRC bank. The parent should remit in CNY or USD under the SAFE transaction code for inbound direct investment equity capital into the WFOE's Foreign Exchange Capital Account. The underlying remittance instruction must quote the FDI registration code, shareholder name, and equity subscription details. After the bank credits the funds, the WFOE converts into RMB in a capital settlement account and must use the proceeds strictly for operating purposes within the registered business scope, not for loans, securities, or real-estate investment. A certified PRC accountant will then issue the capital verification report for company registration and future capital account revision.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For imports of ingredients and kitchen equipment, use SWIFT MT103 for open-account trade with verified invoices and customs declarations; for bulk purchases or unavoidable supplier terms, issue an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit through the corporate bank, supported by the purchase contract and shipping documents. Documentary collections D/P or D/A may be used for medium-sized transactions with confirmed trading partners. For royalty and franchise fee outflows to the Hong Kong IP holder, the WFOE must file the service trade contract, apply to the bank for payment under an approved service-trade purpose code, submit the tax withholding completion certificate for PRC withholding taxes, and settle the remittance through the bank's real-time clearing systems.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY/USD forward contracts supported by verified current-account trade invoices or cash-flow projections under the SAFE real-demand principle
CNY/USD foreign exchange swaps to manage timing mismatches between USD capital injection and future RMB operating disbursements
Cross-currency interest rate swaps only where a foreign-currency loan or capital lease is genuinely embedded in the balance sheet

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permitted for the onshore WFOE; any CNH market hedging must be restricted to the Hong Kong parent's consolidated treasury and cannot be applied as a SAFE-registered onshore instrument

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (NAR1) of a private company, confirming members, shareholding, directors, secretary, and registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Companies Registry, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 calendar days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation in Hong Kong
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fee escalates from HK$870 (over 42 days up to 3 months) to HK$1,740 (over 3 months up to 6 months) and HK$3,480 (over 6 months). The company and each responsible person are liable on prosecution to fines up to HK$50,000 plus a daily default fine. Continued default may cause the Companies Registry to treat the company as not carrying on business and to initiate administrative strike-off and dissolution by gazette notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business registration certificate annual renewal and continuation of business registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Business Registration Office, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal application must be made within 1 month before the expiry of the current Business Registration Certificate; the certificate is valid for one year from the commencement date and is renewable annually or triennially at election
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Carrying on business without a valid business registration certificate is an offence under the Business Registration Ordinance (Cap. 310), punishable by a fine up to HK$5,000 and imprisonment up to 1 year. The Inland Revenue Department may also treat the continued absence of a valid certificate as evidence of cessation of business, potentially triggering Companies Registry deregistration or strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profits Tax Return (BIR51) for corporations, accompanied by audited financial statements and tax computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Profits Tax Division, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within 1 month from the due date stated on the return; tax representatives may obtain block extension dates up to 15 August or 15 November depending on the company's accounting period end date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing may attract a fine up to HK$10,000. The Inland Revenue Department may issue estimated assessments; in cases of deliberate evasion, additional tax of up to 3 times the undercharged tax may be imposed. Directors and officers may be prosecuted where the company fails without reasonable excuse.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Employer's Return of Remuneration and Pensions (IR56B) for all directors and employees receiving remuneration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Employee Tax Section, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 April following the end of the year of assessment (1 April to 31 March), unless an electronic filing extension is granted
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file without reasonable excuse is an offence punishable by a fine up to HK$10,000. The employer may also be prosecuted, and the Inland Revenue Department may raise estimated salary tax assessments against each affected employee, with additional penalty and interest.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No quantitative turnover, balance sheet, or headcount exemption applies to an active private limited company in Hong Kong. Under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), every company incorporated in Hong Kong must appoint an independent practising certified public accountant as auditor and must have its financial statements audited annually, unless the company qualifies as dormant under section 5 of the Companies Ordinance and has passed a special resolution of members. A WFOE operating an active fast-casual Malatang self-serve franchise business is therefore mandatorily subject to annual independent CPA audit. The first auditor must be appointed within 9 months of incorporation, and audited financial statements must be submitted with the Profits Tax Return to the Inland Revenue Department.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS), which are aligned with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Eligible private entities may apply HKFRS for Private Entities, but full HKFRS is expected where the company is assessable to Hong Kong profits tax and presents general-purpose financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Hong Kong does not impose a 30-day UBO reporting window or a separate annual UBO filing to the Companies Registry. Instead, each Hong Kong company must maintain a Significant Controllers Register (SCR) at its registered office, identifying every individual with significant control over the company, generally ownership or control of more than 25% of shares or voting rights. The register must be updated within 7 days of any notifiable change, and must be available for inspection by the Companies Registry and law enforcement on demand. Shareholding transfers are recorded promptly in the Register of Members and the annual member snapshot is certified on the NAR1 Annual Return within 42 days of the incorporation anniversary. Changes of directors, company secretary, or registered office must be filed with the Companies Registry within 15 days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book containing minutes of general meetings, board meetings, and resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - 1,000 per annum for a licensed corporate service provider, registered office address, and company secretary in Hong Kong
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 - 5,000 per annum for a low-risk franchise and trading WFOE, including audit, tax computation, and unaudited preparation support, subject to transaction volume and group structure

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The mainland PRC WFOE is a Chinese resident enterprise taxed at 25% on worldwide income. Preferential reliefs relevant to a Malatang self-serve franchise master-licensing vehicle include: (i) the 15% reduced enterprise income tax rate for a certified High/New Technology Enterprise under CIT Law Article 28; (ii) the 20% reduced rate for small low-profit enterprises, currently producing an effective 5% rate on annual taxable income up to RMB 3 million; (iii) the 100% super deduction for qualified R&D expenditure; (iv) the 10% accelerated depreciation on validly used equipment; and (v) accelerated 10-year loss carryforward for eligible high-technology SMEs, but no general patent box for brand royalty income unless the IP is a patented or high-tech qualifying asset.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form A-Series, Form A000000/A100000), filed via the State Taxation Administration's National Electronic Tax Platform (e-Tax Electronic Tax Bureau); quarterly prepayments are filed on Form A200000 through the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayments are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the annual CIT return and final settlement are due within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e. 31 May for a calendar-year WFOE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Record gross revenue from Malatang franchise master-licensing, initial franchise fees, ongoing royalty income, supply-chain sales, training and self-serve equipment rental.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All income of the WFOE, including income from franchisees located abroad, is reported on the accrual basis because the WFOE is a PRC resident taxpayer. Contracts with related non-resident franchisees or with the Hong Kong parent must be newly recognized in the Related Party Transactions Statements, with transfer-pricing support for royalty rates, service fees, and goods margins; any foreign-source fee not commercially justified is exposed to recharacterisation and withholding tax substance review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare direct costs of broths, seasonings, dry goods, packaging, utensils, POS hardware, and kitchen equipment supplied to franchisees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Inbound supplies from the Hong Kong affiliate must be substantiated by customs import records, commercial invoices, and title-transfer documentation. If the goods are sourced through the HK intermediary, the resale price method or TNMM must substantiate an arm's length gross margin; lack of supporting import documents triggers non-deduction and potential customs and VAT consequences.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Include selling expenses, franchise support labor, rental, utilities, information systems, and insurance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Management fees, royalty, and interest paid to the non-resident parent are deductible only if actually incurred, arm's length, and supported with invoices and withholding certificates. Under CIT Law Article 37, a payer that fails to withhold tax on cross-border royalties/services will lose the deduction and incur the withholding penalties described below.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Non-taxable Income and Exempt Income Lines
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report government grants, qualifying income from the State's non-taxable catalogue, and enumerated exemptions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Subsidies received from local authorities for restaurant chain expansion are generally taxable unless explicitly exempted. A WFOE cannot mask non-resident franchise royalty income as non-taxable by contract re-labelling; the substance of the payment governs source and character.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute taxable income by adding disallowed expenses, deducting tax-exempt income, and applying carryforward losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border payments to the Hong Kong parent are added back to taxable income if they are not at arm's length, lack business substance, fail the documentation rules, or are excessive by thin capitalisation, intercompany financing, or royalty adjustment. Losses generated by an artificial Hong Kong conduit cannot be used to offset mainland taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Tax Rate and Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 25% headline rate or a preferential rate based on qualifying status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE claims the 15% high-tech rate or the 5% effective small-low-profit rate, the entity must complete the corresponding preferential tax schedule and retain supporting records of CIGA in China. The WFOE's own income tax must not be confused with the withholding tax obligation on dividends, royalties, and interest paid to the HK parent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Prepayments, Credits, and Foreign Tax Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Record quarterly prepayments and any foreign tax credit for income taxes paid abroad on foreign-source income attributable to the PRC taxpayer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE may credit only genuine income taxes paid in a foreign jurisdiction on income that is actually sourced abroad; a Hong Kong tax payment that has no real activity behind it is not creditable and may be challenged as circular or tax avoidance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Related Party Disclosure and Non-resident Withholding Schedules
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Complete non-resident payment tables, related party transaction reporting forms, and the enterprise income tax withholding summary for dividends, interest, royalty, and service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Every payment stream to Hong Kong must be mapped to the exact WHT category. The WFOE must identify the claimed China-Hong Kong DTA rate, the date on which the HK parent's Tax Residency Certificate and beneficial ownership declaration were received, and the amount withheld and paid to the tax authority. Discrepancies between Box 8 and the annual related-party transaction report are a common trigger for special tax audits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing is penalized under the PRC Tax Administration Law Article 62 (fines up to RMB 2,000; RMB 10,000 in serious cases). Late payment attracts an additional daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax. A false or inaccurate return leading to underpaid tax is a tax evasion offence under Article 63, with a penalty of 50% to 5 times the evaded tax, and criminal prosecution under PRC Criminal Law Article 201 if the evaded amount exceeds RMB 50,000 and is more than 10% of the tax payable, giving custodial and fine exposure for the responsible legal representative and financial director. Withholding agents who fail to withhold or remit are fined 50% to 3 times the un-withheld amount under Article 69.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory PRC WHT on dividends paid by a resident enterprise to a non-resident enterprise; reduced to 5% under the Mainland and Hong Kong DTA where the beneficial owner is a Hong Kong resident company holding directly at least 25% of the capital of the PRC WFOE throughout the 12 months before dividend payment.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim the 5% DTA rate, the Hong Kong shareholder must obtain a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department, provide the Chinese withholding agent with a beneficial ownership declaration and documentary chain proving that the HK entity is the true owner of the dividend and not a conduit, and must complete the treaty-rate application through the withholding agent's electronic filing before payment. The PRC withholding agent keeps the TRC, probative corporate registers, board resolutions, holding-period proof, and bank records. If the HK shareholder lacks economic substance and staff in Hong Kong, the tax authority may deny treaty relief under the beneficial ownership clause and the general anti-abuse rule, so the 10% statutory WHT and late-payment interest must be settled.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest payments to a HK non-resident are subject to 10% statutory WHT and a 7% DTA rate; royalties for trademarks, know-how, and copyrights are subject to 10% statutory WHT and a 5% DTA rate.
